tagline: Step inside every topic of GCSE Computer Science

topics.title: Systems architecture
topics.description: The CPU, the fetch-execute cycle, performance and embedded systems.

topics.title: Memory and storage
topics.description: RAM, ROM, virtual memory, secondary storage, units and data representation.

topics.title: Computer networks, connections and protocols
topics.description: Networks, hardware, the internet, topologies, connections and protocols.

topics.title: Network security
topics.description: Forms of attack and the ways networks are protected from them.

topics.title: Ethical, legal, cultural and environmental impacts
topics.description: The impact of digital technology on people and the planet, and the laws that apply.

groups.name: Paper 2: Computational thinking, algorithms and programming

topics.title: Algorithms
topics.description: Computational thinking, designing algorithms, searching and sorting.

topics.title: Programming fundamentals
topics.description: Variables, constants, the three basic constructs, data types and operators, string and file handling, records and SQL, arrays, sub-programs and random numbers.

topics.title: Producing robust programs
topics.description: Defensive design, testing and maintainable code.

topics.title: Boolean logic
topics.description: Logic gates, truth tables and logic diagrams.

topics.title: Programming languages and IDEs
topics.description: High- and low-level languages, translators and IDE tools.

groups.name: Learning to program
groups.blurb: A full Python course, beyond the OCR J277 specification — for teaching programming and tracking progress

topics.title: Python programming
topics.description: Thirteen lessons of Python written and run in the browser, from your first printed line through to merge sort and SQL. Every question is marked as it is answered, so progress shows lesson by lesson.

guides.title: How the Python course works
guides.description: The screen explained, Run against Check, the seven kinds of activity, what to do when something goes wrong, and all thirteen lessons. Six pages.

guides.title: Python syntax guide
guides.description: Every command the course teaches, with what it does and an example. The same list as the Syntax reminder button, on paper. Eight pages.
